title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库收录了 Fernando Amaral 教授的完整人工智能培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、大语言模型、生成式 AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等。包含理论讲解和 Python 实践项目与笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for the Complete Artificial Intelligence Training by Prof. Fernando Amaral, covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, etc., with theory and hands-on Python projects and notebooks.
